text_recipe: annotation_view_lowercase; old human view must equal immutable minimal view
primary_validation: Same original-425 validation IDs for baseline and augmented training; never compare scores on different validation populations
additional_labels: human or human_reviewed_ai only; REVIEW/EXCLUDE and AI-only suggestions stay outside training
new_post_assignment: Existing baseline post follows frozen fold; unseen post hash(seed,group) modulo 5; no label-dependent assignment
leakage: Hold complete post groups out; remove additional train exact/near validation matches; block if baseline frozen split leaks
